_comments.usage: External Codex skills installed by targets/codex/install.sh into $CODEX_DIR/skills/<name>/. Each entry is shallow-cloned and <path> (which must contain SKILL.md) is copied.
_comments.claude: The Claude Code side of these tools is tracked separately in plugins.json (humanize-korean@im-not-ai, humanizer@humanizer).
_comments.humanizer: blader/humanizer documents no official Codex install; its root SKILL.md is self-contained, so the repo root is installed as the skill directory.
